When I was 18 pr 19 years old, I once got VERY pissed off. Probably the most pissed off at anything I've ever been in my life. It was over something someone said to me. I clenched my fists, screamed a battle cry, raised my right hand, and threw it at the wall. As soon as my hand started moving, I became surrounded in a green light. Time was progressing VERY slowly. I seemed to be outside my body and was extremely calm, just observing (I was seeing/being from a spot just outside my neck, in front of me). I watched as the fingers on my hand straightened very slowly, while my hand moved towards the wall, also very slowly. I realized that what I was watching was still happening in real time outside of the green light, but for me, it was happening VERY slowly. From my perspective, it took about 2 minutes for my hand to the wall, which was about an elbow distance from me.

I calmly watched the slow movement, I focused on the green light for a while. It felt peaceful to be inside and I wasn't worried about anything at all. I watched how there were different shades of green in the light, and how it fluctuated/rippled as the light moved around my body. These fluctuations/ripples were happening faster than my body was moving, which must have been extremely fast given how slowly my body appeared to be moving, even though I know the hand was moving very quickly outside the light.

As the fingers of my hand neared contact with the wall, I thought that they might become injured hitting a wall. I wondered if some of that light/energy could be focused around the fingers. As soon as I thought that, it happened. Some of the light/energy surrounded the fingers and became VERY dark in colour. I watched as the fingers went through the wall as if they were hitting water. I watched for what seem like a minute as the fingers sliced through the wall, going through drywall and wood, making around a one foot long hole in the wall. There was no effort and the wall just gave way.

It was then that that my mom yelled my name from upstairs and I snapped back into reality. The light was gone, I was very calm and just a little bit disoriented at not knowing what I had just seen. I no longer cared about what was said to me, I let it go.

I was completely sober when this happened. It has never happened since, but I have never been really angry since that has happened either.
